tasks.short: Assess patients' mental and physical status

steps.what: Review the relevant patient history and presenting complaints
Interview the patient about symptoms, functioning and current concerns
Examine and observe the patient's physical and mental presentation
Assess the patient's current status and significance of the findings
Write the immediate assessment findings and status in the examination record

tasks.design: Configure a focused assessment view and existing examination fields in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record. The nurse interviews, examines and assesses personally, then writes the actual findings; no diagnostic judgement is delegated.
tasks.previous_blocker: Relevant history and examination fields may require repeated screen navigation and heading entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Native record views and assessment-field layouts can remove that clerical navigation.
tasks.still_hard: Symptoms, observed behaviour and physical findings need clinical interpretation.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse notices discrepancies and adapts the assessment in person.
tasks.altitude: Less navigation and record setup with unchanged assessment responsibility.

evidence.claim: Native clinical views and reusable assessment fields can reduce clerical setup; no clinical or time outcome is measured for this design.

assumptions: The immediate examination record is part of assessment and is written in s5. Task17329 reuses it in longitudinal documentation rather than repeating its authoring; no additional assessment log is introduced.

The nurse obtains symptoms in s2 and produces observed findings in s3 and assessment in s4, then captures them in s5. Existing care staff produced historical record entries through earlier care. All current evidence gathering and actual field entry remain; missing context requires manual review.

OTHER is the electronic patient record. Native views remove three of15 navigation hours; examination headings remove two of10 repeated-context entry hours. Actual clinical findings, review and ordinary saves remain without a self-approval gate.
No score, structured risk flag, automated triage or machine send is assumed.
unknowns: Whether the current assessment view already contains these fields
research_questions: Which navigation and repeated headings can be removed without omitting relevant assessment context?

already_counted.description: Record review and actual examination entry remain in s1 and s5.

incremental.description: Nurse checks assessment-view fields after record changes.

approvals.approved_version: Actual assessment question or statement checked for the patient's situation before speaking; changed questions require renewed judgement.
Actual examination action, patient and immediate clinical conditions checked before performance; changed conditions require a fresh check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R95, gross5 less upkeep1 gives net4. Low0 retains current work when the native view already supplies the required context and no change is adopted. High2.5 retains13 history-review hours and8.5 examination-entry hours because some context still requires separate screens, plus75 clinical hours: R96.5, net2.5. Central retains12 review and eight entry hours with compatible fields.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Diagnose psychiatric and mental health conditions

steps.what: Review assessment evidence, prior diagnoses and applicable diagnostic references
Diagnose the condition while considering alternatives and uncertainty
Discuss the diagnostic formulation and uncertainty with the patient
Write the diagnosis, rationale and uncertainty in the diagnostic record

tasks.design: Use native diagnostic-evidence views in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, and current reference links in {DOCS}. The nurse makes the diagnosis, discusses uncertainty and writes the actual formulation; reusable headings remove only small clerical setup.
tasks.previous_blocker: Evidence navigation and repeated diagnostic headings can add clerical work around clinical judgement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native views can surface original evidence and current reference links together.
tasks.still_hard: Differential diagnosis and uncertainty are clinical judgements.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse considers context and discusses meaning with the patient.
tasks.altitude: Slightly easier evidence access with unchanged diagnostic responsibility.

reach.learn: Which uncertainties need further clinical investigation

evidence.claim: Native evidence views and diagnostic headings may shorten clerical navigation; no automated psychiatric diagnosis capability or outcome is claimed.

assumptions: The immediate diagnostic formulation is written here once. Task17329 incorporates this existing entry into longitudinal documentation without reauthoring it. The practitioner acts within existing professional scope and local rules.

The assessment process produces examination findings; earlier clinicians produced historical entries. The nurse checks originals in s1, produces the clinical formulation in s2 and writes its rationale in s4. All new diagnostic evidence or uncertainty requires retained clinical work; no free diagnostic code is assumed.

OTHER is the electronic patient record. Native evidence links remove three of20 navigation hours. Reusable headings remove one of10 setup hours; clinical rationale and ordinary same-system saves remain fully retained without self-approval.
No diagnostic model, code suggestion, automatic referral or patient-message send is proposed.
unknowns: Whether the existing record already has focused diagnostic views
research_questions: Can the view reduce navigation while preserving access to conflicting evidence and prior diagnostic uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Evidence review and diagnostic record writing remain in s1 and s4.

incremental.description: Nurse checks diagnostic reference links after updates.

approvals.approved_version: Actual patient-specific diagnostic explanation and stated uncertainty checked before speaking; changed formulation requires renewed judgement.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R96, gross4 less upkeep0.5 gives net3.5. Low0 retains current work when evidence links and headings are already native and no change is adopted. High2 retains18.5 evidence-review hours and nine record-writing hours because some references remain separate, plus70 diagnosis/discussion hours: R97.5, net2. Central retains17 evidence hours and nine writing hours; clinical reasoning is unchanged.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Document histories, findings, plans, prescriptions and outcomes

steps.what: Assemble source histories, findings, plans, prescriptions and outcome information
Clarify missing history, treatment or outcome details with the patient
Draft the longitudinal clinical narrative from the actual documentation sources

loop.purpose: Draft narrative documentation from captured clinical facts
loop.input: Nurse-selected original source entries and manually captured clarification facts
loop.output: Narrative under existing headings with source references and explicit missing information
loop.check: Nurse checks every statement for factual support, negation, chronology, attribution, clinical uncertainty and omitted relevant facts against originals; unsupported claims are removed
loop.stop: One draft only; unsupported or contradictory sections are written manually and missing facts return to clarification
loop.why_not_simpler: Native headings and source reuse come first; the remaining work is organising varied narrative facts rather than copying fixed fields

steps.what: Correct and write the clinical narrative in the patient record

tasks.design: Reuse native source views and clinical-note headings in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record, before adding a bounded narrative draft. The nurse captures missing facts, checks meaning, corrects the text and writes the actual record personally; the model neither diagnoses nor commits the record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Longitudinal narratives require repeated organisation and rewriting of already available facts.
tasks.enabler_now: A source-linked drafting assistant can organise supplied text while leaving correction and record entry with the clinician.
tasks.still_hard: Negation, sensitive attribution, chronology and uncertain psychiatric history are easy to misstate.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse decides what the clinical record must say and verifies its meaning.
tasks.altitude: Reduce narrative drafting while retaining clinical source checking and authorship.

reach.task: Use longitudinal records in ongoing care

evidence.claim: Autoscriber drafts consultation records with clinician validation and supported patient-record integration; that supports reviewed drafting, not autonomous clinical authorship.
The Capio Ramsay Santé study reports self-estimated note time falling from6.69 to4.72 minutes with93-second median editing; its population and note boundary do not establish this task's saving.
The task-specific drafting and source-view estimates are unmeasured scenarios.

assumptions: This is longitudinal documentation assembly and narrative writing. Immediate assessment findings are authored in17331 and diagnostic formulation in17334; they are sources here, not a second claim to the same authoring time. Treatment, prescription and outcome documentation still require actual entry here; prescribing decisions themselves remain outside this documentation task.

The nurse produces clinical source entries in the corresponding care processes and manually captures new clarification facts in s2/s3. s1 counts source selection and identity/date checks; s2 counts all clarification; s3 retains27 hours including entry of new facts, source/meaning review and fallback. No transcript, risk flag or structured prescription is assumed to appear free.

OTHER is the electronic patient record. Native source views remove three of20 navigation hours. The bounded draft removes18 of45 narrative-organisation hours, retaining27 for actual facts and source checking plus all20 correction/final writing hours.

The nurse's own same-system save is an ordinary retained part of writing, with no approval stage and no saving. There is no machine commit, separate referral send or ambient recording process in this design.
unknowns: Whether the remaining narrative is sufficiently supported by accessible original entries
Whether source-linked drafting saves time after meaning checks
research_questions: On comparable psychiatric notes, does total source selection, drafting, correction and entry time fall without omissions or invented facts?

already_counted.description: Clarification, meaning review, correction and final record writing remain in s2, s3 and s4.

incremental.description: Nurse samples draft accuracy after source-format or model changes.

approvals.approved_version: Actual clarification question or statement checked for patient relevance before speaking; changed questions require renewed judgement.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R79, gross21 less upkeep2 gives net19. Low5 retains all20 source hours and38 narrative hours where histories conflict and most text needs manual organisation, plus35 clarification/final-writing hours: R93, net5. High12 retains19 source and32 narrative hours with partially comparable sources, plus35 other hours: R86, net12. Central retains17 source and27 narrative hours only with compatible accessible source text; no study percentage sets the range.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Educate patients and families about mental health and treatment

steps.what: Find current patient information matching the condition and treatment plan
Choose the education topics and safe scope for this patient and family
Prepare the existing written education material for the chosen topics
Check and give the final education material to the appropriate recipients
Educate the patient and family about the condition and chosen treatment
Check understanding and address remaining questions or misconceptions
Write topics taught and remaining education needs in the existing education fields

tasks.design: Index vetted information and reuse existing education handout sections in {DOCS}. The nurse chooses scope, checks the actual handout, teaches and checks understanding, then writes existing education fields in {OTHER}, the electronic patient record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Reference search and repeated handout setup add work around patient education.
tasks.enabler_now: Native topic indexes and reusable approved sections remove specific preparation operations.
tasks.still_hard: Distress, literacy, family participation and individual treatment questions require a clinician.
tasks.human_edge: The nurse adapts the discussion and verifies what the patient understood.
tasks.altitude: Prepare reliable materials faster while retaining patient-specific teaching.

reach.learn: Which remaining needs should guide the next conversation

evidence.claim: Thuisarts provides guideline-based patient information; this supports vetted reference material, not automatic patient-specific advice.
Education preparation and field-entry savings are unmeasured local estimates.

assumptions: Existing handouts and education fields are read by the patient and continuing care team. Their actual preparation, handover and writing are included; no extra conversation transcript is introduced. These specialised education fields are not rewritten in17329's longitudinal narrative.

The care process produces the treatment plan and vetted content owners maintain information. The nurse validates both in s1, establishes education needs and family participation in s2 and observes understanding in s6, then captures actual topics and remaining needs in s7. Missing information requires manual clarification; no free understanding score is assumed.

OTHER is the electronic patient record. Topic indexing removes3.75 of15 search hours; approved sections remove4.5 of15 handout setup hours; existing field defaults remove0.5 of five repeated-context entry hours. Actual advice, understanding checks and record writing remain.
Ordinary author saves have no gate and no saving. No model-generated advice, automatic patient-message send or new approval lifecycle is proposed.
unknowns: Whether current materials already match the chosen topics
Whether education fields are already prefilled with stable context
research_questions: Can approved sections be reused without changing advice meaning or reducing the patient-specific discussion?

already_counted.description: Source checking, handout adaptation and actual education entry remain in s1, s3 and s7.

incremental.description: Nurse checks reference links and approved sections after guidance changes.

approvals.approved_version: Exact handout version, clinical topic and permitted recipients checked before handover; changed content or family participation invalidates the check.
Actual patient-specific explanation checked against current plan and references before speaking; changed questions require renewed clinical judgement.
Actual clarification or corrective advice checked for the observed misunderstanding before speaking; changes require a renewed check.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B100 R91.25, gross8.75 less upkeep1 gives net7.75. Low1 retains14 reference,14 handout and all five entry hours because topic matches are weak and no entry defaults apply, plus65 judgement/handover/teaching/checking hours: R98, net1. High5 retains13 reference,11.5 handout and4.5 entry hours with partly compatible materials, plus65 other hours: R94, net5. Central retains11.25,10.5 and4.5 clerical hours respectively; clinical discussion remains full.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Keep psychiatric assessment, diagnosis and education clinical while reducing specific record and material preparation.
reach: Nurses using accurate longitudinal and education records
role.ambitious_version: A psychiatric nurse who spends less time rebuilding records and materials while remaining responsible for clinical judgement and patient understanding.
